inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Photorealistic cinematic film, 35mm with natural grain, warm tungsten work lamps and a cool blue glow from the gadget, rain streaking the dark skylight, real unretouched skin with visible pores. Keep exactly the faces and costumes of the two men in <Picture 1>; their faces must stay the same people in every frame. The pirate: red patterned bandana, dark deep-set eyes, hollow cheeks, long pointed dark goatee and thin moustache, silver hoop earring, long dark dreadlocks threaded with colourful beads, weathered brown leather coat. The inventor: wild shaggy grey-white hair, brass goggles pushed up on his forehead, very wide pale-blue eyes, short dark beard and moustache, grey work shirt under a stained white lab coat. Normal real-time speed, no slow motion. The inventor (S1) has an excitable, quick, energetic male voice. The pirate (S2) has a deep, gravelly male voice with a dry, teasing edge. One continuous five-second shot. 0-1 s: the camera is already pushing forward past the swaying hanging cables; the inventor twists a tiny screwdriver inside the glowing gadget and a few sparks flick out. 1-2 s: his eyes snap up and, without turning around, the inventor (S1) says: "You're late. It's already awake." 2-3.5 s: the pirate shoves off the door frame and strides in fast, boots thudding, shoulders rolling, a smirk spreading. 3.5-4.5 s: the pirate (S2) says, leaning one hand on the bench: "Machines don't wake up, Doc." 4.5-5 s: the inventor spins round on his stool toward the pirate with a delighted grin and throws his arms open, while the camera keeps pushing in. SPEED IS CRITICAL: everything moves at normal real-time speed, like 24fps footage played back at 24fps - fast, natural motion, NO slow motion. Nobody freezes or holds a pose: bodies, hands, heads and the camera keep moving until the very last frame.

overall_soundscape: Rain drums on the glass skylight, the gadget hums and spits small sparks, a soft crackle from the Tesla coil in the back, heavy boots knocking on the wooden floor, the stool creaking as he spins.
